ios.desc:
Who Goes turns any group into a game night in seconds. Pick a mode, pass the phone around, and let the app handle who is up, what they do, and who is winning. No setup, no scorekeeping, no arguing about whose turn it is.

HEADBANDS
• Hold the phone to your forehead and guess the word everyone else can see
• Tilt down when you get it, tilt up to pass
• 30 decks, from Countries and Brand Names to Back to 90s and Famous Landmarks

TRUTH OR DARE
• 11 themed decks, from Inner Circle and Party Starter to Date Night, After Dark, and Unhinged
• Let Auto Pick choose the player, or go straight to the card
• Keep score across the night and look back at every card played

MR. WHITE
• Everyone gets the same secret word, except one player who gets nothing
• Bluff through the round without giving yourself away, then vote to unmask the imposter
• Nine word packs and a talk timer that keeps every round moving

CHARADES
• Act it out and race the timer while your team shouts guesses
• 30 decks, from Movies and Pop Culture to Bollywood, Superheroes, and Iconic Music
• Play solo or in teams, with a round-up showing who carried it

WOULD YOU RATHER
• Face off over impossible "this or that" dilemmas and watch the group split
• Six categories, from No Good Options to Unhinged. Vote out loud, then see where everyone landed

PICK A CARD
• Split the deck with two fingers and riffle the halves back together
• Draw one card, or deal a hand to the whole table with Plus
• Four card backs, a shuffle from one riffle to three, and a history of every card drawn

QUICK PLAY
• Spin the Bottle to land on who is up, carrying a prompt, truth, dare, or kiss
• Tic Tac Toe for two, with a truth or dare waiting for whoever loses
• Roll the Dice, Coin Toss, Pick One, and Elimination settle anything in seconds
• Build Teams with a draft, Number Everyone to set the order, or toss a coin from the Home Screen widget

HOW EVERYONE PICKS
• Everyone drops a finger on the screen and the chooser decides, so nobody types a name
• Auto Pick shuffles your roster on screen and lands on whoever is up
• Save your group once and reuse it across every game

WHO GOES PLUS
Plus unlocks Would You Rather, the rest of the decks in every mode, the dealing games in Pick a Card, Spin the Bottle prompts, and your own custom words, plus themes, fonts, and customization. Unlock it once with the Lifetime purchase, or choose a subscription. Plans, prices, and any free trial are shown in the app before you confirm.
